findings.note: The line above gives t₁ = 2t₂, so substituting into t₁ + t₂ = t must give 2t₂ + t₂ = t, not 4t₂ + t₂ = t. As printed the left side is 5t₂, which would give t₂ = t/5, so the equation contradicts the result stated on the same line and the whole solution below it.

notes: Final answer at²/3 is correct; only the middle line is false.
